stories.title: User Profile Management Page
stories.description: As an authenticated user, I want to view and update my personal profile information so that my account details remain accurate and up to date.
acceptance_criteria: Display the user's profile information after successful authentication.
Display editable fields for first name, last name, phone number, and profile picture.
Display the user's email address as a read-only field.
Allow users to update their profile information.
Allow users to upload or change their profile picture.
Display a 'Save Changes' button to submit profile updates.
Display a 'Cancel' button to discard unsaved changes.
Display success and error messages based on the update operation.
Load profile information from the backend profile API.
Display a loading indicator while profile data is being fetched.
business_rules: Only authenticated and active users can access their profile.
Users can only update their own profile information.
Email addresses cannot be modified after registration.
Profile updates must be recorded with the latest modification timestamp.
api_requirements: GET /api/v1/users/me - Response: 200 OK with authenticated user's profile details.
PUT /api/v1/users/me - Request: {first_name, last_name, phone_number, profile_image}, Response: 200 OK with updated user profile.
POST /api/v1/uploads/profile-image - Upload profile image and return image URL.
database_tables: users: id (UUID, primary key), first_name (VARCHAR), last_name (VARCHAR), email (VARCHAR, unique), phone_number (VARCHAR), profile_image_url (TEXT), is_active (BOOLEAN), updated_at (TIMESTAMP)
validation_rules: First name is required and must contain only alphabetic characters.
Last name is required and must contain only alphabetic characters.
Phone number must contain exactly 10 digits.
Uploaded profile images must be JPG, JPEG, or PNG format.
Maximum image size should not exceed 5 MB.
ui_requirements: Display the profile page inside a centered responsive card layout.
Display the user's profile picture at the top with an edit icon.
Arrange input fields in a two-column layout on desktop and a single-column layout on mobile devices.
Display labels above each input field.
Use rounded input fields with subtle shadows.
Display Save Changes and Cancel buttons aligned at the bottom-right.
Display success or error alert messages below the page header.
The page must be fully responsive for desktop, tablet, and mobile devices.
